basis: Accepted Task 9 SH-15/SH-16 require persisted reviewed decisions to govern public impact and require unresolved affected paths to block clearance.

reproduction.operation: Publish alpha/spec/1@2, capture context, run public references decide for beta/review/1@1, recapture, then apply that exact persisted decision to public graph impact.
reproduction.outcome: Decision publication changed the captured generation; applying the stored decision returned stale_context/incomplete. The public impact command also did not load persisted decisions. E2E analysis additionally showed that candidate-side traversal of a reviewed old-to-new upstream rebind was rejected because traversal was required to equal only old_upstream.

constraints: Keep intent, accepted spec, and accepted plan unchanged.
Preserve exact owner/ref vectors; exclude only decision-only catalog changes from the dependency-context generation.
Resolve only explicitly selected qualified decision references through trusted public projection.
Apply a reviewed decision only when traversal matches its declared old or new upstream; keep dependent, context, authority, and complete required-path checks intact.
Unresolved or reassessment-required impacted paths must not report complete clearance.
Do not change policy/authority checks or create Red evidence.
